title: Planning a Party
description: Four recordings about a birthday party: planning, shopping, a voicemail and a thank-you speech.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Planning the party
parts.intro: You will hear a girl, Mai, and her dad planning a birthday party.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Mai, let's make a list for your birthday party. How many friends do you want to invite?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Ten, please. Oh, and my cousin Peter, so that's eleven.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That's fine. Shall we have it in the garden?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Not on Saturday. The weather forecast says it will rain. Let's have it on Sunday afternoon.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Good idea. Do you want a theme, like pirates or superheroes?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'd like a space party. Everybody can wear silver clothes.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Lovely. And what about the cake?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: A chocolate cake, shaped like a rocket. Can Grandpa make it? His cakes are the best.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: I'll ask him tonight.

parts.title: Part 2 · Shopping for the party
parts.intro: You will hear Mai's dad shopping with her in a supermarket.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Right, Mai. We need balloons, juice and some snacks. Where shall we start?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Balloons first. Can we get silver and blue ones? Red is too bright for a space party.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Of course. How many packets? There are twenty in each one.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Two packets, please. Then we can put some outside the front door.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Next, the drinks. Orange juice or apple juice?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Orange, but not too sweet. Last year Tom said his was too sugary.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Right. And for snacks? Crisps and popcorn?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Popcorn, yes, but no crisps. Lots of people had them at Anna's party.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: OK. I think that's everything. Let's go to the checkout.

parts.title: Part 3 · A voicemail from a friend
parts.intro: You will hear a boy, Leo, leaving a message for Mai about the party.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: Hi, Mai. It's Leo. Thank you for the invitation to your party.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: I'm very sorry, but I can't come until four o'clock. I have a football match in the morning, and then lunch at my grandmother's house.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: I've bought you a present. It's a book about the planets, with beautiful pictures. I hope you don't have it already.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: Do I need to bring anything? I could bring some games if you like. I've got a big board game about space.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: Please call me back on my mobile. I'll be home all evening. See you on Sunday!

parts.title: Part 4 · Mai's speech
parts.intro: You will hear Mai speaking at the end of her party.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Can I have your attention, please? I'd like to say a few words before everybody goes home.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: First, thank you all for coming and for the wonderful presents. My favourite is the telescope from Mum and Dad. I can't wait to look at the stars tonight.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Second, thank you to Grandpa for the amazing cake. It was delicious, and I think there's still a piece for everybody to take home.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'd also like to thank my dad for taking the photos. He took more than a hundred, and he's going to send them to your parents.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Finally, the winner of the best silver costume is Peter, with his shiny helmet. Congratulations, Peter! You win a little toy rocket.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thank you, everybody. Have a safe journey home!
